verdict.rationale: OCI officially documents Budgets with soft limits and spend alerts, letting founders configure cost guardrails from day one (oracle-cloud-docs-8/21). However, community evidence describes a real incident where an uncaught OCI billing error triggered deletion of hundreds of production servers with major data/financial impact, undermining confidence that OCI's billing/anomaly systems reliably prevent cost or operational disasters (oracle-cloud-comm-11); free-tier users also report abrupt, unannounced resource reclamation/bans tied to usage thresholds (oracle-cloud-comm-1, oracle-cloud-comm-3, oracle-cloud-comm-5). Missing for 10: documented anomaly-detection-on-spend feature (beyond simple threshold alerts), evidence of granular/automated cost anomaly alerts, and independent confirmation that billing safeguards work reliably in practice.
